value.rationale: The theorem supplies a sharp structural boundary for direct maps between finite weak-order pseudospheres: any height mismatch collapses the entire mapping space to one homotopy class. The arbitrary-level-size extension is not a routine parameter increase because larger source levels create the new spanning-target-level configuration handled by a distinct perturbation lemma. The uniform three-edge fence gives an explicit finite-space contraction mechanism with independent reproducibility checks.
